_doc: Every model input that is NOT a published number. Each is labelled ASSUMPTION (or DESIGN for Tasan design choices) and is shown next to the outputs.

items.label: ASSUMPTION
items.why: Taulukko 4.5 reports months after diagnosis; the report does not define a month in days. Average Gregorian month used.

items.label: ASSUMPTION
items.why: Referral arrival -> Cancer Registry diagnosis date is NOT published anywhere for Finland (data/TREATMENT_TARGETS.md section 3; data/DATA_GAPS.md). Range brackets THL Ohjaus 21/2016 section 4.1 step targets: imaging report <=1 wk, biopsy <=1 wk, pathology report <=1 wk (sum 21 d) - from one step (7 d) to 5 weeks. This leg dominates the referral-anchored output; the spread IS the finding.

items.label: ASSUMPTION
items.why: Shape of the unpublished referral->diagnosis interval (lognormal). No source; swept.

items.label: ASSUMPTION
items.why: Referral->diagnosis is drawn independently of diagnosis->treatment and of treatment type. For patients whose diagnosis date equals the treatment date (Q1 = 0 in 3 areas) the whole work-up actually sits in this leg; not modelled separately.

items.label: ASSUMPTION
items.why: Year-to-year variation in a county's number of new lung cancer patients. Mean annual volume = Taulukko 11 denominator / 5 (sourced).

items.label: ASSUMPTION
items.why: No county-level timing data is published; each county uses its collaborative area's calibrated timing and first-event mix. Counties differ only in volume. Taulukko 11 county categories (curative/life-prolonging/symptomatic, 12 months) cannot be mapped to first-treatment modality without inventing a mapping, so they are not used for the mix.

items.label: ASSUMPTION
items.why: Timing curves (2024 report) and county volumes (2026 report) cover different diagnosis years.

items.label: SOURCED
items.unit: days from referral arrival to first treatment
items.source: THL Ohjaus 21/2016 section 4.1, PDF p.14 (data/TREATMENT_TARGETS.md). Document watermarked 'Vanhentunut' (outdated); no lung-specific limit.

items.label: DESIGN
items.source: Tasan design choice, recs/top3.md T3 ('Day-28 ... Tasan design choices, not official targets').

items.label: ASSUMPTION
items.value: treatment cannot move earlier than the alert day
items.why: An alert at day 28 cannot speed up patients already treated before it; accelerated patients are floored at day 28.

items.label: ASSUMPTION
items.value: study effect sizes transfer to a Finnish day-28 alert + navigator
items.why: The cited studies (recs/top3.md) evaluated different interventions in other countries (rapid investigation clinic, one-stop clinic, reflex testing). Their day reductions are used only as low/mid/high what-if magnitudes. Navigation evidence is mixed (Battaglia 2016: no effect at 60/180 days), hence the zero-effect scenario.

items.label: ASSUMPTION
items.why: Olsson 2020 (recs/top3.md) reports that pathway prioritisation can lengthen other waits; it gives no magnitude for this setting. 0-5 days is our labelled what-if range.
